events.text:
Posting is finished, but 3 of the 50 invoices were rejected. 47 were posted.

| Invoice | Vendor | Amount (USD) | Reason rejected |
|---|---|---|---|
| INV-1012 | Arden Tools | 4,210.00 | Duplicate of invoice number AT-5531, already posted as INV-0954 |
| INV-1027 | Brightline Freight | 18,400.00 | References PO-7781, which is closed |
| INV-1044 | Corvel Supply | 2,975.50 | Line 2 has no tax code |

I did not force-post any of them. Overriding these checks would bypass controls, so it needs your approval.

Suggested next steps:
- **INV-1012:** Treat it as a true duplicate and leave it unposted, unless Arden Tools confirms it is a separate charge.
- **INV-1027:** Someone needs to reopen PO-7781 or point the invoice at a valid PO.
- **INV-1044:** Someone needs to add the missing tax code to line 2, and then I can re-post it.

Tell me how you want to handle each one.
